description: This file is a shell script that functions as a test suite for git notes, particularly testing the stripspace behavior in various scenarios. It includes setup, adding, appending, and editing notes with different options, and verifies the outputs against expected results.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Sets up a test commit to be used in subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup command to be run after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.
